packages.title: 7 Days of Kerala (God's Own Country)
packages.route: Kochi → Athirappilly → Munnar → Thekkady → Kumarakom → Alleppey → Trivandrum
packages.subtitle: The ultimate 7-day circuit covering waterfalls, tea estates, tiger reserve, Kumarakom & Kovalam beach.
inclusions: Private AC Vehicle with experienced driver

itinerary.title: Kochi → Athirappilly → Munnar
itinerary.subtitle: Welcome to God's Own Country! Begin your journey with lush green drives and cascading waterfalls.
activities: Kochi Airport / Railway Station pickup by private chauffeur
Direct transfer to Athirappilly Waterfalls sightseeing
En route Cheeyappara Waterfalls & Valara Waterfalls photo stops
Check-in at Munnar hotel & evening leisure time

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.subtitle: Explore emerald tea hills, natural acoustic points, and high-altitude lakes.
activities: Mattupetty Dam visit & optional speedboat ride
Kundala Lake pedal boating & scenic photo spots
Guided walk through sprawling Tea Plantations
Top Station mountain viewpoint / Optional sightseeing

itinerary.title: Munnar → Thekkady
itinerary.subtitle: Experience the wild side of Kerala amid lush forests, spices, and serene lakes.
activities: Scenic hill drive to Thekkady spice country
Guided Spice Plantation tour (cardamom, pepper, cinnamon)
Optional Periyar Lake boating & wildlife spotting

itinerary.title: Thekkady → Kumarakom
itinerary.subtitle: Relax by the tranquil backwaters and enjoy the calm, village life of Kerala.
activities: Scenic transfer to Kumarakom lagoon shores
Leisure time at luxury lakeside resort

itinerary.title: Kumarakom → Alleppey
itinerary.subtitle: Drift into tranquility as you cruise through the enchanting backwaters of Alleppey.
activities: Check-in to traditional Deluxe Houseboat with welcome drink & lunch
Afternoon & sunset backwater cruise through village canals
Overnight stay on Alleppey Houseboat with freshly cooked dinner

itinerary.title: Alleppey → Trivandrum
itinerary.subtitle: Relax on golden beaches and explore the rich culture and heritage of Trivandrum.
activities: Kovalam Beach relaxation & ocean promenade walk

itinerary.title: Trivandrum Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Take back memories that last a lifetime!
activities: Visit sacred Sri Padmanabhaswamy Temple & Napier Museum
Local handicraft shopping & souvenirs free time
Drop at Trivandrum Airport / Railway Station with lifelong memories!

packages.title: Munnar Escape
packages.route: Arrival → Munnar → Mattupetty → Top Station → Drop
packages.subtitle: Scenic mountains • Waterfalls • Tea Gardens • Adventure • Valley Views
inclusions: 2 Nights stay at a 3★ property with swimming pool
Private Sedan car for all transfers & sightseeing
All mentioned sightseeing as per itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival → Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.subtitle: Pickup from designated point & proceed to Munnar enjoying cascading waterfalls and tea valleys.
activities: Check-in & Overnight stay in Munnar 3★ Resort

itinerary.title: Mattupetty & Top Station Route
itinerary.subtitle: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day sightseeing tour towards Mattupetty & Top Station.
activities: Mattupetty Dam & Sunmoon Valley Boating Point
Shooting Point & Wild Elephant Arrival Spot

itinerary.title: Munnar Local Sightseeing → Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Explore Munnar's picturesque hills before proceeding for your departure transfer.
activities: Gap Road Route (subject to weather & time availability)
After sightseeing, proceed for comfortable drop-off!

packages.title: 5 Days / 4 Nights Kerala Tour
packages.subtitle: Complete Kerala highlights: Tea estates, spice hills, and Alleppey Houseboat cruise.
inclusions: Private AC Vehicle for all transfers & sightseeing
Alleppey sharing Houseboat Stay with traditional meals
Driver & complete sightseeing as per itinerary
Pickup from Kochi & drop-off at Kochi Airport/Station

itinerary.title: Kochi → Munnar
itinerary.subtitle: Pickup from Kochi Airport / Railway Station and drive to the misty hills of Munnar.
activities: Pickup from Kochi Airport / Railway Station
Drive to Munnar with en-route sightseeing
Hotel check-in & overnight stay in Munnar

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.subtitle: Full-day exploration of Munnar's iconic tea gardens and reservoirs.
activities: Return to hotel & overnight stay in Munnar

itinerary.title: Munnar → Thekkady
itinerary.subtitle: Travel to Thekkady spice sanctuary with optional Kathakali & Kalaripayattu cultural shows.
activities: Scenic hill drive from Munnar to Thekkady
Optional Kathakali & Kalaripayattu martial arts shows
Optional Periyar Lake boating & wildlife activities

itinerary.title: Thekkady → Alleppey
itinerary.subtitle: Breakfast & checkout, drive to Alleppey jetty for a memorable houseboat cruise.
activities: Drive to Alleppey & check-in to Kerala Houseboat

itinerary.title: Alleppey → Kochi Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Morning breakfast on houseboat followed by transfer to Kochi Airport / Railway Station.
activities: Transfer to Kochi Airport / Railway Station
End of the Kerala trip with beautiful memories!
